title: What If Naruto Read ONE More Line Of The Forbidden Scroll? — Part 4: The Signature

NARRATOR.description: Warm, grounded, dramatic storyteller with a dry streak.

NARUTO.description: Loud, stubborn, hungry for acknowledgement. Goes quiet only when it matters.

CLONE.description: Naruto's voice, slightly brighter and faster. Bickering shadow clones.

KURAMA.description: Deep, slow, cavernous. Post FX echo.

KABUTO.description: Friendly, soft-spoken, a little too pleasant.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: Seven failures. Seven smiles. Someone is failing the Chunin Exam on purpose, and a twelve year old filing clerk just noticed.

visuals.query: hundreds of genin sitting the written Chunin exam
Kabuto smiling with his glasses glinting

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: Naruto Uzumaki reads whatever his clones learn. He's emptied the archive and built a bridge. He does not get stronger. He gets to read first.

visuals.query: Naruto reading a file in the Hokage's archive
towering shelves of scrolls and files in the archive

beats.speaker: CLONE
beats.text: Boss. This guy's failed the exam seven times.

visuals.query: a Naruto clone holding up a document in the archive

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.text: Seven? Nobody's that bad at anything. Pull his file.

visuals.query: Naruto close up, serious, narrowed eyes

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: Kabuto Yakushi. Seven failed exams, one friendly smile, and in canon, every single failure is on purpose.

visuals.query: Kabuto's thin file open on a desk
Kabuto smiling with his glasses glinting

chapters.title: THE MAN WHO FAILED ON PURPOSE

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: Kabuto's file is thin and spotless. A clean record, a kind face, and a photograph where he smiles like he knows where the camera is hidden.

visuals.query: Kabuto's thin file open on a desk
Kabuto smiling with his glasses glinting

beats.speaker: CLONE
beats.text: Boss, he's polite in every single report. Nobody's polite in every single report.

visuals.query: a Naruto clone holding up a document in the archive

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.text: Everybody gets one complaint. Iruka's got eleven. I've got a whole shelf.

visuals.query: Naruto reading a file in the Hokage's archive

beats.speaker: CLONE
beats.text: And Kabuto has none.

visuals.query: a Naruto clone holding up a document in the archive

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.text: Then let's go say hello.

visuals.query: Naruto close up, serious, narrowed eyes

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: Registration day. The exam hall smells of nerves and floor wax, and near the door a young man in round glasses is handing out cards like a shopkeeper.

visuals.query: hundreds of genin sitting the written Chunin exam
Kabuto fanning out his info cards

beats.speaker: KABUTO
beats.text: First time? Don't be shy. I'm Kabuto Yakushi. I've failed this exam seven times, so I know where all the mistakes are.

visuals.query: Kabuto smiling with his glasses glinting

beats.speaker: KABUTO
beats.text: These are info cards. Every genin in the village, every mission, every stat. Take a look. They're free.

visuals.query: Kabuto fanning out his info cards

beats.speaker: SASUKE
beats.text: Show me mine.

visuals.query: Sasuke in the exam hall holding out a hand

beats.speaker: KABUTO
beats.text: Sasuke Uchiha. Sharingan, clean record, no wounds worth a note. And Naruto Uzumaki. Oh, this one's easy.

visuals.query: Kabuto fanning out his info cards

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: Kabuto turns the card around for half a second. Naruto reads it twice. Shadow clones, never more than ten at a time. Once slept nineteen hours straight.

visuals.query: Naruto staring at an info card in the exam hall
Kabuto fanning out his info cards

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: That isn't in any file. Naruto would know. He filed every file.

visuals.query: Naruto staring at an info card in the exam hall

beats.speaker: KABUTO
beats.text: Good luck in there, Naruto. Try not to collapse.

visuals.query: Kabuto smiling with his glasses glinting

beats.speaker: SASUKE
beats.text: Hn. He's too friendly. I don't like it.

visuals.query: Sasuke in the exam hall holding out a hand

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.text: Wow. We agree. Somebody mark the date.

visuals.query: Naruto staring at an info card in the exam hall

beats.speaker: CLONE
beats.text: Boss. Maybe he guessed.

visuals.query: a Naruto clone holding up a document in the archive

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.text: Nobody guesses nineteen hours.

visuals.query: Naruto close up, serious, narrowed eyes

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: He doesn't go home. He goes straight up the Hokage tower, past two startled guards, and he doesn't knock.

visuals.query: Naruto running through Konoha
the Third Hokage at his desk smoking his pipe

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.text: Old man. There's a genin in the exam with cards that know things. I've read your archive, every shelf. He knows things that aren't in it.

visuals.query: Naruto frowning in the Hokage's office

beats.speaker: HIRUZEN
beats.text: Kabuto Yakushi. Seven attempts and not one complaint. Hm.

visuals.query: the Third Hokage close up, tired, pipe in hand

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.text: Somebody who's very good at not being in the paperwork. That's who.

visuals.query: Naruto frowning in the Hokage's office

beats.speaker: HIRUZEN
beats.text: Then we don't throw him out. A spy we can see is a spy we can read.

visuals.query: the Third Hokage at his desk smoking his pipe

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: The old man's left hand forms a cross seal on the desk. He doesn't notice. Naruto does. He files that away for later.

visuals.query: the Third Hokage's left hand forming a cross seal on his desk
Naruto frowning in the Hokage's office

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: The written exam. Two hundred genin, a wall clock, and chunin along every wall. At the front stands Ibiki Morino, who has never once been called friendly.

visuals.query: hundreds of genin sitting the written Chunin exam
Ibiki Morino standing at the front of the exam hall

beats.speaker: IBIKI
beats.text: Ten questions. The tenth comes last. Get caught cheating and you lose points. Get caught enough and you lose the exam.

visuals.query: Ibiki Morino standing at the front of the exam hall

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: Nine questions on the page. Not one a genin could answer. Naruto reads number five and nearly laughs. It isn't a question. It's a dare.

visuals.query: Naruto at his desk in the exam hall
a nearly blank exam paper on Naruto's desk

beats.speaker: SAKURA
beats.text: Naruto, why aren't you writing anything?

visuals.query: Sakura at her desk in the exam hall

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.text: I'm working. Quietly. Mostly.

visuals.query: Naruto at his desk in the exam hall

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: So the clerk in him stops reading the paper and starts reading the room. Every chunin has a clipboard. Every clipboard has a column. Every column is a name.

visuals.query: Naruto at his desk in the exam hall
Ibiki Morino scarred face close up

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.text: They're not grading the paper. They're grading us.

visuals.query: Naruto at his desk in the exam hall

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: The first Chunin exam tests information gathering. In canon, you were supposed to cheat. You just weren't supposed to get caught.

visuals.query: hundreds of genin sitting the written Chunin exam
Kabuto fanning out his info cards

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: Naruto doesn't cheat. He does something sneakier. A clone, transformed into a pencil, rolls quietly under Kabuto's desk.

visuals.query: a Naruto clone transformed into a pencil on the exam hall floor

beats.speaker: CLONE
beats.text: Boss. I'm a pencil. I have never been so humiliated.

visuals.query: a Naruto clone transformed into a pencil on the exam hall floor

beats.speaker: CLONE
beats.text: Kabuto's copying the girl two rows ahead. He's not even looking down. Nobody's caught him.

visuals.query: a Naruto clone transformed into a pencil on the exam hall floor

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.text: Good. Write all of it down.

visuals.query: Naruto at his desk in the exam hall

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: Then Ibiki asks the tenth question. Leave now and fail with your team, or stay and risk never being a chunin again. Half the room walks out. Naruto stays.

visuals.query: Ibiki Morino scarred face close up
hundreds of genin sitting the written Chunin exam

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.text: I'm not going anywhere. I've never once left before the last page.

visuals.query: Naruto at his desk in the exam hall

beats.speaker: IBIKI
beats.text: Everyone who stayed passes. Uzumaki, your paper is blank.

visuals.query: Ibiki Morino standing at the front of the exam hall

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.text: Yeah. That isn't the exam. This is.

visuals.query: Naruto at his desk in the exam hall

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: Four pages. Every cheater by row and method, and one name circled three times. Ibiki reads it standing up.

visuals.query: Ibiki Morino scarred face close up
Naruto at his desk in the exam hall

beats.speaker: IBIKI
beats.text: Kid, you handed me a report instead of an exam.

visuals.query: Ibiki Morino scarred face close up

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.text: Isn't that the same thing?

visuals.query: Naruto at his desk in the exam hall

beats.speaker: IBIKI
beats.text: Today it is.

visuals.query: Ibiki Morino standing at the front of the exam hall

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: Across the hall, Kabuto's smile doesn't move. But for the first time, someone in the room is writing down exactly why.

visuals.query: Kabuto smiling with his glasses glinting
Naruto at his desk in the exam hall

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: The second exam is the Forest of Death. Five days, one scroll each, a wall of trees, and Anko Mitarashi, who loves her job far too much.

visuals.query: genin crowd at the gate of the Forest of Death
Anko Mitarashi at the gate of the Forest of Death

beats.speaker: ANKO
beats.text: Welcome to the Forest of Death! Sign the waiver. If you die, don't blame me. Blame the tigers.

visuals.query: Anko Mitarashi at the gate of the Forest of Death

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.text: Is it too late to pick a smaller forest?

visuals.query: Naruto crouched on a branch in the Forest of Death

beats.speaker: ANKO
beats.text: Yes! The gate opens in five minutes!

visuals.query: Anko Mitarashi at the gate of the Forest of Death

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: The night before, Naruto knocked on one more door. Anko Mitarashi opened it with a dango stick in her teeth.

visuals.query: Anko Mitarashi close up, face going still

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.text: I read your file. And your old teacher's. If anyone from the Grass shows up in that forest, don't be the last person to find out.

visuals.query: Naruto close up, serious, narrowed eyes

beats.speaker: ANKO
beats.text: Where did you get that name, kid?

visuals.query: Anko Mitarashi close up, face going still

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.text: Unclassified shelf, filed under O. It's not a secret. Nobody just wanted to read it.

visuals.query: Naruto reading a file in the Hokage's archive

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: Anko doesn't say thank you. She does something more useful. She puts four ANBU on the tower roof and swallows the dango stick whole.

visuals.query: Anko Mitarashi close up, face going still
ANBU squads on a tower roof

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: Then the gate opens. The Second Hokage invented the Shadow Clone Jutsu for scouting, and Naruto finally uses it that way. Two hundred clones, two hundred trees, ten at a time.

visuals.query: hundreds of Naruto clones perched in the trees of the Forest of Death

stamp.label: CANON
stamp.note: Created by the Second Hokage for scouting.

beats.speaker: CLONE
beats.text: Boss, tree forty. A snake the size of a bus, eating a boar. Not ours.

visuals.query: a Naruto clone crouched on a branch scouting

beats.speaker: CLONE
beats.text: Boss, a tiger's sitting on a team from Rain. The team's fine. The tiger looks confused.

visuals.query: a Naruto clone crouched on a branch scouting

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.text: Mark both. We go west.

visuals.query: Naruto crouched on a branch in the Forest of Death

beats.speaker: CLONE
beats.text: Boss, west has a lake. There's a very large frog in it.

visuals.query: a Naruto clone crouched on a branch scouting

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.text: Is it friendly?

visuals.query: Naruto crouched on a branch in the Forest of Death

beats.speaker: CLONE
beats.text: It's eating the tiger. I'd say no.

visuals.query: a Naruto clone crouched on a branch scouting

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.text: Okay. South of the frog, then.

visuals.query: Naruto crouched on a branch in the Forest of Death

beats.speaker: SASUKE
beats.text: Why are we walking in a circle?

visuals.query: Sasuke moving through the Forest of Death

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.text: It's not a circle. It's around the bad bit.

visuals.query: Naruto crouched on a branch in the Forest of Death

beats.speaker: SAKURA
beats.text: What bad bit?

visuals.query: Sakura in the Forest of Death

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.text: Every bad bit. I've got a map. It's in my head, and my head is in two hundred trees.

visuals.query: Naruto crouched on a branch in the Forest of Death

beats.speaker: SASUKE
beats.text: This feels like cheating.

visuals.query: Sasuke moving through the Forest of Death

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.text: It's called scouting. A guy invented it. Look him up.

visuals.query: Naruto crouched on a branch in the Forest of Death

beats.speaker: CLONE
beats.text: Boss. Grass team, sector eleven. Three genin. Two of them walk like genin.

visuals.query: a Naruto clone crouched on a branch scouting

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.text: And the third one?

visuals.query: Naruto crouched on a branch in the Forest of Death

beats.speaker: CLONE
beats.text: His feet don't make a sound. The leaves don't move. And his eyes are yellow. He blinked sideways.

visuals.query: a Naruto clone crouched on a branch scouting

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: Below, the Grass team stops. The third genin tilts his head and looks up into the canopy, at two hundred trees and one clone that looks right back.

visuals.query: Orochimaru disguised as a Grass genin with yellow snake eyes
Naruto clones scattered through the canopy

beats.speaker: OROCHIMARU
beats.text: Strange. The forest feels like it's counting us.

visuals.query: Orochimaru disguised as a Grass genin with yellow snake eyes

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: Naruto remembers page forty of an old file. A missing nin, a yellow gaze, a student who learned everything and kept the wrong parts.

visuals.query: Naruto crouched on a branch in the Forest of Death
Orochimaru disguised as a Grass genin with yellow snake eyes

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.text: Orochimaru.

visuals.query: Naruto crouched on a branch in the Forest of Death

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: He pops a messenger clone. It runs, one branch every half second, straight to the tower where Anko is waiting.

visuals.query: a Naruto clone crouched on a branch scouting

beats.speaker: CLONE
beats.text: Grass team, sector eleven! Yellow eyes! The boss says do not engage!

visuals.query: a Naruto clone crouched on a branch scouting

beats.speaker: ANKO
beats.text: Understood. Nobody goes near the Grass team. Tell him thank you. And tell him I said it quietly.

visuals.query: Anko Mitarashi at the gate of the Forest of Death

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: By the time her squad reaches sector eleven, the Grass team is gone. A headband sits folded on a branch, and that's all.

visuals.query: Anko Mitarashi at the gate of the Forest of Death
ANBU squads on a tower roof

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: Team Seven never meets Orochimaru. Nobody bites Sasuke's neck. In canon, this is the afternoon that changes him.

visuals.query: Sasuke moving through the Forest of Death
Team Seven moving through the forest

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: They reach the tower on day three with both scrolls and not a scratch. Then two hundred trees of tiredness arrive at once, and Naruto falls asleep standing up.

visuals.query: Team Seven moving through the forest
Naruto crouched on a branch in the Forest of Death

beats.speaker: SAKURA
beats.text: Naruto? Naruto! He's asleep. Standing up.

visuals.query: Sakura in the Forest of Death

beats.speaker: SASUKE
beats.text: Leave him. He earned it.

visuals.query: Sasuke moving through the Forest of Death

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: The month before the final. Sasuke Uchiha has a problem, and the problem is orange. Naruto keeps getting ahead of him.

visuals.query: Sasuke close up, scowling, Sharingan active
Naruto sparring at the training ground

beats.speaker: SASUKE
beats.text: How many hours do you train?

visuals.query: Sasuke close up, scowling, Sharingan active

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.text: Two thousand a day. Sort of. It's mostly clones. I mostly nap.

visuals.query: Naruto sparring at the training ground

beats.speaker: SASUKE
beats.text: That isn't fair.

visuals.query: Sasuke close up, scowling, Sharingan active

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.text: No. It's maths, ya know.

visuals.query: Naruto sparring at the training ground

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: Sasuke's goal is older than the exam, older than Team Seven, older than his headband. Falling behind the dead last was never part of it.

visuals.query: Sasuke close up, scowling, Sharingan active
the empty Uchiha district at dusk

beats.speaker: SASUKE
beats.text: I need to be stronger. Nothing else matters. Not you, not the exam.

visuals.query: Sasuke close up, scowling, Sharingan active

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.text: Okay. Then use me.

visuals.query: Naruto sparring at the training ground

beats.speaker: SASUKE
beats.text: What did you say?

visuals.query: Sasuke close up, scowling, Sharingan active

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.text: Forty sparring partners, whenever you want them. And every report ever filed on the Sharingan. Who beat it. Who lost to it. How.

visuals.query: Naruto reading a file in the Hokage's archive

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: It's the only way Naruto knows to say I'm on your side. He doesn't say it out loud. He's a filing clerk. He files it.

visuals.query: Naruto sparring at the training ground
Sasuke close up, scowling, Sharingan active

beats.speaker: SASUKE
beats.text: Why would you help me?

visuals.query: Sasuke close up, scowling, Sharingan active

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.text: Nobody ever trained with me. So I know exactly what it's worth.

visuals.query: Naruto sparring at the training ground

beats.speaker: SASUKE
beats.text: Fine. Forty. Start now.

visuals.query: Sasuke attacking at the training ground

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: Forty Narutos, ten at a time. Sasuke's Sharingan catches every pattern, so Naruto shows it nothing twice.

visuals.query: Naruto clones crowded around tables of files
Sasuke attacking at the training ground

beats.speaker: CLONE
beats.text: Ow! He hit me! Boss, he hit me!

visuals.query: a Naruto clone holding up a document in the archive

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.text: I know. I felt it.

visuals.query: Naruto sparring at the training ground

beats.speaker: SASUKE
beats.text: Why do you keep flinching?

visuals.query: Sasuke close up, scowling, Sharingan active

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.text: Because I'm the one who gets hit.

visuals.query: Naruto sparring at the training ground

beats.speaker: SASUKE
beats.text: Again. Faster this time.

visuals.query: Sasuke attacking at the training ground

beats.speaker: CLONE
beats.text: Boss, I don't want to be next.

visuals.query: a Naruto clone holding up a document in the archive

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.text: You're a clone. You're always next.

visuals.query: Naruto sparring at the training ground

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: The Sharingan reads motion. The reports read habit. By week three, Sasuke has lost to the same boy twelve different ways and learned something from every one.

visuals.query: Sasuke attacking at the training ground
Naruto sparring at the training ground

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: Kakashi shows up three hours late to a session he didn't schedule. He's always late. Every single time.

visuals.query: Kakashi reading his book at the training ground

beats.speaker: KAKASHI
beats.text: I see someone's been reading about me.

visuals.query: Kakashi reading his book at the training ground

beats.speaker: SASUKE
beats.text: About the Sharingan.

visuals.query: Sasuke close up, scowling, Sharingan active

beats.speaker: KAKASHI
beats.text: Same thing.

visuals.query: Kakashi reading his book at the training ground

beats.speaker: SAKURA
beats.text: Can I train with you two as well?

visuals.query: Sakura at the training ground

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.text: Sure! I've got a file on chakra control. It's mostly about you.

visuals.query: Naruto sparring at the training ground

beats.speaker: SAKURA
beats.text: Why is there a file about me?

visuals.query: Sakura at the training ground

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.text: You're really good at it. I read it for fun.

visuals.query: Naruto sparring at the training ground

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: Sasuke doesn't say thank you. At sundown he says, same time tomorrow. From an Uchiha, that's a speech.

visuals.query: Team Seven at the training ground
Sasuke close up, scowling, Sharingan active

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: A week before the final, a clone files a hospital incident report. Patient, Rock Lee. Cause of injury, sand. Eleven witnesses. None of them can say how it moved.

visuals.query: Konoha hospital corridor
Naruto reading a hospital incident report

beats.speaker: CLONE
beats.text: Boss. The sand moved before he was hit. It guarded him. And the Sand genin's chart says nobody's ever seen him sleep.

visuals.query: a Naruto clone holding up a document in the archive

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.text: Never sleeps. Huh.

visuals.query: Naruto reading a hospital incident report

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: He knows one other person who sleeps badly. That night Naruto closes his eyes and walks down into the dark, past the bars, to ask the only expert in the village.

visuals.query: Naruto standing before Kurama's cage
Kurama's red eye behind the bars

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.text: Hey, fox. You awake?

visuals.query: Naruto standing before Kurama's cage

beats.speaker: KURAMA
beats.text: Always, brat. Your snoring echoes.

visuals.query: Kurama's red eye behind the bars

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.text: I don't snore.

visuals.query: Naruto standing before Kurama's cage

beats.speaker: KURAMA
beats.text: You do. I have twelve years of data, brat.

visuals.query: Kurama looming behind the cage bars

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.text: That Sand kid. The sand that moves on its own. Is that like you?

visuals.query: Naruto standing before Kurama's cage

beats.speaker: KURAMA
beats.text: Shukaku. A raccoon dog with a sand fixation and no manners.

visuals.query: Kurama looming behind the cage bars

beats.speaker: KURAMA
beats.text: That raccoon never sleeps because his cage is badly made.

visuals.query: Kurama's red eye behind the bars

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.text: What's a badly made cage?

visuals.query: Naruto standing before Kurama's cage

beats.speaker: KURAMA
beats.text: A cheap lock. A maker in a hurry, or afraid. The bars don't hold, so the prisoner never rests, and neither does the boy.

visuals.query: Kurama looming behind the cage bars

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: Kurama is quiet for a long moment. It's the same quiet as a clone reading to him in the dark.

visuals.query: Kurama's red eye behind the bars
Naruto standing before Kurama's cage

beats.speaker: KURAMA
beats.text: Mine was made well. By a man who loved the boy it was for. I hate that I know that.

visuals.query: Kurama's red eye behind the bars

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: The next night Naruto finds Gaara on a rooftop at the edge of the village. Sand curls around his feet like a pet that has learned not to be loved.

visuals.query: Gaara standing on a rooftop at night

beats.speaker: GAARA
beats.text: Leave. Everyone who comes this close dies. It's the only reason anyone comes.

visuals.query: Gaara standing on a rooftop at night

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.text: I'm not here to fight. I read the report on Lee. The sand moves before you do.

visuals.query: Naruto on a rooftop at night

beats.speaker: GAARA
beats.text: It protects me.

visuals.query: Gaara standing on a rooftop at night

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.text: From who?

visuals.query: Naruto on a rooftop at night

beats.speaker: GAARA
beats.text: Everyone.

visuals.query: Gaara close up, sand swirling around him

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.text: You don't sleep, do you? Because if you sleep, he takes the wheel.

visuals.query: Naruto on a rooftop at night

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: The sand stops moving. For the first time since Naruto arrived, Gaara looks at him.

visuals.query: Gaara close up, sand swirling around him

beats.speaker: GAARA
beats.text: Who told you that?

visuals.query: Gaara close up, sand swirling around him

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.text: Nobody. Mine talks too. Mine just reads over my shoulder.

visuals.query: Naruto on a rooftop at night

beats.speaker: GAARA
beats.text: Then you're lying, or you're the same as me.

visuals.query: Gaara standing on a rooftop at night

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.text: I got lucky. People walked toward me. Late, but they walked. You got a cage with a bad lock.

visuals.query: Naruto on a rooftop at night

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.text: That doesn't make you the monster. It means whoever built it was in a hurry.

visuals.query: Naruto on a rooftop at night

beats.speaker: GAARA
beats.text: Stop talking.

visuals.query: Gaara close up, sand swirling around him

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.text: Okay. I can't fix it. I'm not gonna pretend I can. I just wanted someone to say it out loud.

visuals.query: Naruto on a rooftop at night

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: It cures nothing. Gaara doesn't thank him. But the sand that has moved for him every night for years hesitates for one second, and then it stays still.

visuals.query: Gaara close up, sand swirling around him
Gaara standing on a rooftop at night

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: Naruto walks home with no plan for this one. For the first time in a month, he has nothing filed.

visuals.query: Naruto on a rooftop at night

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: The month ends at the mail desk. One envelope from the Hidden Sand, sealed in wax. It confirms the Kazekage's seat at the Chunin final.

visuals.query: Naruto at the mail desk sorting letters
two diplomatic letters side by side, signatures compared

beats.speaker: CLONE
beats.text: Boss, standard form. He's coming. He wants the good chair.

visuals.query: a Naruto clone holding the sealed Sand envelope

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.text: Read me the signature.

visuals.query: Naruto at the mail desk sorting letters

beats.speaker: CLONE
beats.text: Soft. Round. Every downstroke curves. Looks like a swan wrote it.

visuals.query: a Naruto clone holding the sealed Sand envelope

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: Naruto stops. He walks to a drawer, pulls out an old letter filed under S, and lays the two side by side.

visuals.query: Naruto at the mail desk sorting letters
two diplomatic letters side by side, signatures compared

beats.speaker: CLONE
beats.text: Boss, you said the old one signs like he's stabbing the page.

visuals.query: a Naruto clone holding the sealed Sand envelope

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.text: He did. He pressed so hard the brush split. This man doesn't press at all.

visuals.query: Naruto at the mail desk sorting letters

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: Same name, same seat, same wax. One signature stabs the page. The other flows like water. A man can change his face. He doesn't change his hand by accident.

visuals.query: a letter signed with split brush downstrokes
a letter signed in soft elegant brushwork

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.text: He's dead. The Kazekage's dead, and somebody's signing in his place.

visuals.query: Naruto at the mail desk sorting letters

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: In canon, he's right. Orochimaru killed the Fourth Kazekage and took his chair, and the Sand never knew.

visuals.query: a letter signed in soft elegant brushwork
Orochimaru in the Kazekage's hat in the Kage box

beats.speaker: CLONE
beats.text: Boss. That's a head of state.

visuals.query: a Naruto clone holding the sealed Sand envelope

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.text: I know. That's the problem.

visuals.query: Naruto at the mail desk sorting letters

beats.speaker: CLONE
beats.text: Should we tell somebody?

visuals.query: a Naruto clone holding the sealed Sand envelope

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.text: We're going to tell everybody. Nobody's going to listen.

visuals.query: Naruto at the mail desk sorting letters

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: He takes it to Kakashi first. Kakashi reads both letters for a long minute, which for Kakashi is a very long time.

visuals.query: Kakashi reading his book at the training ground
two diplomatic letters side by side, signatures compared

beats.speaker: KAKASHI
beats.text: Naruto. I like you. But a signature isn't a body.

visuals.query: Kakashi reading his book at the training ground

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.text: It's the last habit a body keeps. And this one's a swan.

visuals.query: Naruto at the mail desk sorting letters

beats.speaker: KAKASHI
beats.text: It's a lovely theory. Nobody will believe it.

visuals.query: Kakashi reading his book at the training ground

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.text: If I'm right, you'll have to explain it to the council.

visuals.query: Naruto at the mail desk sorting letters

beats.speaker: KAKASHI
beats.text: And if you're wrong, I'll have to explain you.

visuals.query: Kakashi reading his book at the training ground

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: He's right. The council hears about it in eleven minutes and laughs for twelve. Only one elder doesn't.

visuals.query: Danzo seated at the council table

beats.speaker: DANZO
beats.text: A boy who reads handwriting. Keep him close, Hiruzen.

visuals.query: Danzo seated at the council table

beats.speaker: HIRUZEN
beats.text: I intend to.

visuals.query: the Third Hokage at his desk smoking his pipe

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: Nobody believes a filing clerk about a head of state. Nobody except the old man who hired him.

visuals.query: the Third Hokage at his desk smoking his pipe
Naruto frowning in the Hokage's office

beats.speaker: HIRUZEN
beats.text: Show me.

visuals.query: the Third Hokage close up, tired, pipe in hand

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: The Third Hokage studies the two signatures for a long time. Then he lowers his pipe.

visuals.query: the Third Hokage close up, tired, pipe in hand
two diplomatic letters side by side, signatures compared

beats.speaker: HIRUZEN
beats.text: I taught that hand its letters. The neatest brush in my class. Never pressed hard on anything, even then.

visuals.query: the Third Hokage close up, tired, pipe in hand

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.text: You know who it is.

visuals.query: Naruto frowning in the Hokage's office

beats.speaker: HIRUZEN
beats.text: I know who I'm afraid it is. That isn't the same thing.

visuals.query: the Third Hokage close up, tired, pipe in hand

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.text: He'll sit beside you. In front of ten thousand people, in the best seat in the stadium.

visuals.query: Naruto frowning in the Hokage's office

beats.speaker: HIRUZEN
beats.text: Protocol. The Hokage sits beside the Kazekage. If I don't, he knows.

visuals.query: the Third Hokage at his desk smoking his pipe

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.text: Old man. Why are you the one sitting in that chair?

visuals.query: Naruto frowning in the Hokage's office

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: The old man's left hand forms a cross seal on the desk. He still hasn't noticed. Naruto has been noticing for a month.

visuals.query: the Third Hokage's left hand forming a cross seal on his desk

beats.speaker: HIRUZEN
beats.text: Who said it would be me?

visuals.query: the Third Hokage close up, tired, pipe in hand

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: The Chunin final. Ten thousand seats, every one full, and a village that believes the worst thing today can bring is a bad match.

visuals.query: the full Chunin final arena packed with spectators
Naruto in the stands of the Chunin final arena

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: Sasuke isn't here. Neither is Kakashi. In canon, both arrive late to the final, and the match is nearly forfeited.

visuals.query: the full Chunin final arena packed with spectators
Sasuke arriving in the arena

stamp.label: CANON
stamp.note: Late to the Chunin final, too.

beats.speaker: CLONE
beats.text: Boss. I'm a filing box in the exam office. A proctor just put his coffee on me.

visuals.query: a Naruto clone disguised as a filing box in an office

beats.speaker: CLONE
beats.text: The Sand kid asked about Sasuke's match. The proctor showed him the postponement form. Filed three days ago.

visuals.query: a Naruto clone disguised as a filing box in an office

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.text: Whose handwriting?

visuals.query: Naruto in the stands of the Chunin final arena

beats.speaker: CLONE
beats.text: Yours, Boss. Obviously.

visuals.query: a Naruto clone disguised as a filing box in an office

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: Nobody can disqualify a boy who has been officially delayed. Naruto filed the form before anyone knew they'd need it. That's what a clerk is for.

visuals.query: Naruto in the stands of the Chunin final arena
Sasuke arriving in the arena

beats.speaker: KAKASHI
beats.text: Sorry we're late. A black cat crossed my path.

visuals.query: Kakashi arriving in the arena reading his book

beats.speaker: SASUKE
beats.text: He made us take the long way around the whole village.

visuals.query: Sasuke arriving in the arena

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.text: Right on time. Technically.

visuals.query: Naruto in the stands of the Chunin final arena

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: Above them, in the Kage's box, the Hokage and the Kazekage sit side by side. The Hokage smokes his pipe. The Kazekage smiles at nothing.

visuals.query: the Third Hokage in the Kage box wearing his hat
Orochimaru in the Kazekage's hat in the Kage box

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: Then the feathers fall. White, soft, drifting over the stands like snow. In ten seconds, ten thousand people are asleep.

visuals.query: the full Chunin final arena packed with spectators
Kabuto standing among the sleeping spectators

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: Kabuto is the only one still standing. The ANBU assigned to watch him are asleep in the third row, and so is Naruto.

visuals.query: Kabuto standing among the sleeping spectators
Naruto in the stands of the Chunin final arena

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: The plan has a hole, and it's exactly the shape of an ANBU squad. Ten squads were meant to hold the gates. All ten are dreaming, and Sound ninja are already coming over the walls.

visuals.query: the full Chunin final arena packed with spectators
ANBU squads on a tower roof

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: On the roof, four violet flames go up, four Sound ninja take their corners, and a dome closes over the Kage's box. The Kazekage removes his hat.

visuals.query: the Four Violet Flames barrier closing around the stadium roof
Orochimaru inside the violet flame barrier

beats.speaker: OROCHIMARU
beats.text: Hello, Sensei. It's been so long. You've grown old.

visuals.query: Orochimaru in the Kazekage's hat in the Kage box

beats.speaker: HIRUZEN
beats.text: So have you, Orochimaru. You used to knock.

visuals.query: the Third Hokage in the Kage box wearing his hat

beats.speaker: OROCHIMARU
beats.text: This barrier holds until one of us stops breathing. I'd hoped it would be you.

visuals.query: Orochimaru inside the violet flame barrier

beats.speaker: HIRUZEN
beats.text: I'm sure you did.

visuals.query: the Third Hokage in the Kage box wearing his hat

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: The Third Hokage can use shadow clones, and he's been using one all afternoon. It pops.

visuals.query: the Third Hokage in the Kage box wearing his hat
Orochimaru inside the violet flame barrier

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: On the roof, the real Hokage feels the entire conversation arrive at once. Jiraiya stands on his left. Four ANBU wait behind him. They've been there since dawn.

visuals.query: Jiraiya on the stadium roof
ANBU squads on a tower roof

beats.speaker: JIRAIYA
beats.text: Orochimaru. You always did set a lovely fire.

visuals.query: Jiraiya on the stadium roof

beats.speaker: HIRUZEN
beats.text: Your barrier is excellent. But a boy read your handwriting.

visuals.query: the Third Hokage on the stadium roof

beats.speaker: OROCHIMARU
beats.text: A boy? Sensei, since when do you take advice from clerks?

visuals.query: Orochimaru inside the violet flame barrier

beats.speaker: HIRUZEN
beats.text: Since one of them started being right.

visuals.query: the Third Hokage on the stadium roof

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: It should end there. But Naruto's plan needed somebody awake in the stands, and every awake person in it is a filing box.

visuals.query: Naruto in the stands of the Chunin final arena
a Naruto clone disguised as a filing box in an office

beats.speaker: CLONE
beats.text: Boss! Boss, wake up! Boss!

visuals.query: a Naruto clone disguised as a filing box in an office

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: The box can't shout through a genjutsu. But it remembers rule three. A clone that gets hit pops, and he keeps the hit. The only way to hit a sleeping boy is to hit someone else.

visuals.query: a Naruto clone disguised as a filing box in an office
Naruto in the stands of the Chunin final arena

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: The box drops its disguise, walks out into the open, and lets a Sound ninja put a kunai in its shoulder.

visuals.query: Naruto clones running through the arena stands

beats.speaker: CLONE
beats.text: Ow. Okay. That one's mine.

visuals.query: Naruto clones running through the arena stands

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: The clone pops. In the stands, Naruto jolts awake with a stab in his shoulder and a minute of someone else's afternoon.

visuals.query: Naruto in the stands of the Chunin final arena

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.text: That hurts. Okay. Okay. Everybody's asleep.

visuals.query: Naruto in the stands of the Chunin final arena

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.text: Forty clones is four batches. That's a four hour headache later. Fine. Fine.

visuals.query: Naruto in the stands of the Chunin final arena

beats.speaker: KABUTO
beats.text: Impressive. Nobody wakes up from that. Not even jonin.

visuals.query: Kabuto standing among the sleeping spectators

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.text: One of me got stabbed. It's a long story.

visuals.query: Naruto in the stands of the Chunin final arena

beats.speaker: KABUTO
beats.text: You're a very strange boy, Naruto.

visuals.query: Kabuto standing among the sleeping spectators

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: He can't wake ten thousand people. But he can wake forty. Every genjutsu report he ever filed says the same thing. Pain breaks it. So forty Narutos run the rows.

visuals.query: Naruto clones running through the arena stands
Naruto in the stands of the Chunin final arena

beats.speaker: CLONE
beats.text: Sorry! Emergency! Sorry! Sorry!

visuals.query: Naruto clones running through the arena stands

beats.speaker: IRUKA
beats.text: Naruto? Did you just slap me?

visuals.query: Iruka in the stands

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.text: Sorry, sensei! It was an emergency!

visuals.query: Naruto running through Konoha

beats.speaker: IRUKA
beats.text: Then go! I'll take the left side!

visuals.query: Iruka in the stands

beats.speaker: SAKURA
beats.text: Naruto, you slapped me!

visuals.query: Sakura waking in the arena stands

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.text: You were asleep! It counts as medicine!

visuals.query: Naruto running through Konoha

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: Kabuto doesn't fight a boy with forty witnesses. He's gone before the third slap.

visuals.query: Kabuto standing among the sleeping spectators

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: Ten squads wake up angry and head for the gates, and two late arrivals head for them faster.

visuals.query: Sasuke arriving in the arena
Kakashi arriving in the arena reading his book

beats.speaker: KAKASHI
beats.text: Sasuke, east gate. I'll take the west one.

visuals.query: Kakashi arriving in the arena reading his book

beats.speaker: SASUKE
beats.text: Try not to be late.

visuals.query: Sasuke arriving in the arena

beats.speaker: KAKASHI
beats.text: I'm already here. Give me some credit.

visuals.query: Kakashi arriving in the arena reading his book

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: And in the middle of the arena, Gaara stands alone. The sand is up. It isn't moving.

visuals.query: Gaara standing alone in the arena with his gourd

beats.speaker: GAARA
beats.text: The man in the white hat gave the order. He said he was my father.

visuals.query: Gaara standing alone in the arena with his gourd

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.text: He wasn't. I've got the handwriting. I'm sorry.

visuals.query: Naruto in the stands of the Chunin final arena

beats.speaker: GAARA
beats.text: Then who has been giving the orders?

visuals.query: Gaara standing alone in the arena with his gourd

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: Gaara doesn't answer. The sand rises, then lowers. It cures nothing. But it doesn't go for Naruto, and it doesn't go for the village. After a while, he just leaves.

visuals.query: Gaara standing alone in the arena with his gourd
Naruto in the stands of the Chunin final arena

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: On the roof, Orochimaru fights his old teacher and his old teammate for four minutes. He loses ground every minute. The barrier falls when the ANBU take the last of the Sound Four.

visuals.query: Orochimaru inside the violet flame barrier
Jiraiya on the stadium roof

beats.speaker: OROCHIMARU
beats.text: Who wrote this plan, Sensei? It isn't yours. It's far too tidy.

visuals.query: Orochimaru inside the violet flame barrier

beats.speaker: HIRUZEN
beats.text: A clerk.

visuals.query: the Third Hokage on the stadium roof

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: Orochimaru does what he has always done when a plan goes wrong. He leaves. He keeps his arms. Hiruzen lets him go, because the village needs its Hokage more than it needs a grudge.

visuals.query: Orochimaru inside the violet flame barrier
the Third Hokage on the stadium roof

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: The Sand shinobi hold their line for an hour. Then word spreads that the Kazekage's chair held a stranger, and they have no reason left to be here. By dusk, the invasion is over. It lasted one afternoon.

visuals.query: smoke over the Hidden Leaf rooftops
the full Chunin final arena packed with spectators

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: In canon, the Third Hokage dies on that roof. Tonight he's in a hospital bed with a stitched shoulder, a burned sleeve, and strong opinions about the soup.

visuals.query: the Third Hokage in a hospital bed

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.text: Old man. You're alive.

visuals.query: Naruto reading a hospital incident report

beats.speaker: HIRUZEN
beats.text: So I'm told. I'd like it noted that I planned this.

visuals.query: the Third Hokage close up, tired, pipe in hand

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.text: You did not. I planned this.

visuals.query: Naruto reading a hospital incident report

beats.speaker: HIRUZEN
beats.text: Then I'd like it noted that I approved it.

visuals.query: the Third Hokage close up, tired, pipe in hand

beats.speaker: HIRUZEN
beats.text: Naruto. Tell the village I'm fine. Tell them the soup is a crime.

visuals.query: the Third Hokage close up, tired, pipe in hand

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: Naruto's reward is paperwork. The aftermath of the invasion. Eleven thousand pages, one night, forty clones. They finish by sunrise.

visuals.query: Naruto clones crowded around tables of files
towering shelves of scrolls and files in the archive

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: Years from now, as Seventh Hokage, Naruto will run the whole village this way. Tonight it's just a very long form.

visuals.query: Naruto clones crowded around tables of files
the Third Hokage at his desk smoking his pipe

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: At two in the morning he finds a gap on the shelf marked Uchiha. Not a missing file. A missing order.

visuals.query: Naruto in the archive at night looking up from a file
the empty Uchiha district at dusk

beats.speaker: CLONE
beats.text: Boss. The night the Uchiha clan died. There's no mission order for it. Nothing at all.

visuals.query: a Naruto clone holding up a document in the archive

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.text: Somebody gave an order. Somebody always gives an order.

visuals.query: Naruto in the archive at night looking up from a file

beats.speaker: CLONE
beats.text: There's a leave slip, though. One ANBU captain, signed out for the night. Look who countersigned it.

visuals.query: a Naruto clone holding up a document in the archive

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: A leave slip for the night the Uchiha clan died. And at the bottom, in a hand he has seen across a council table, one countersignature.

visuals.query: a leave slip with a countersignature
Danzo seated at the council table

beats.speaker: CLONE
beats.text: Boss. It says Danzo.

visuals.query: a Naruto clone holding up a document in the archive

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.text: Don't say it twice.

visuals.query: Naruto in the archive at night looking up from a file

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: He looks up. Naruto knows everyone in this village by their footsteps. He didn't hear these.

visuals.query: Naruto in the archive at night looking up from a file
Sasuke close up, scowling, Sharingan active

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.text: How long have you been standing there?

visuals.query: Naruto in the archive at night looking up from a file

beats.speaker: SASUKE
beats.text: Long enough.

visuals.query: Sasuke close up, scowling, Sharingan active
